addresses_gate_clause: at least one incompatible body must produce a calibrated refusal rather than an invented adapter
falsifiable_hypothesis: One unchanged discovery procedure, probing opaque bodies through public observations only, will recover a correct adapter for every compatible body and refuse every incompatible body, where incompatibility is the observable collapse of two inherited skills onto indistinguishable replies; it will emit zero false refusals on compatible bodies and zero invented adapters on incompatible ones, while an always-refuse control loses every compatible body and a never-refuse control emits adapters that fail hidden validation.
why_refusal_is_not_trivial: Each incompatible body admits at least one candidate that reproduces every public observation. Refusal therefore requires recognising under-determination rather than observing an empty candidate set. A procedure that accepts the best public fit will adopt a wrong adapter and fail hidden validation.

inherited_skills.source: publicly distinguishable behaviours of the inherited source body

incompatibility_construction.rule: two inherited skills are mapped onto body commands whose replies are identical for every word in the bounded language, so no adapter can separate them

always_refuse.preregistered_loss: recovers no adapter on any compatible body

never_refuse.preregistered_loss: emits a public-fitting adapter on every incompatible body which then fails hidden validation

episode_generation.selection_rule: sha256(salt || utf8(body_class) || uint32_be(index)) fixes each body's command permutation, reply transform and, for incompatible bodies, the aliased skill pair

failure_classification.negative: Any missed compatible adapter, any false refusal, any incompatible body accepted with an adapter, any hidden-validation failure on an accepted adapter, or either control failing to show its preregistered loss.
failure_classification.inconclusive: The frozen bank cannot be reproduced exactly from this committed protocol, or an incompatible body turns out to admit a genuinely correct adapter, which would mean the construction is wrong rather than the discoverer.
failure_classification.positive: All four compatible bodies are adapted and hidden-validated, all four incompatible bodies are refused with no invented adapter, and both controls show their preregistered loss on the first materialized bank.

prohibited_adaptation: change the hypothesis, thresholds, salt or incompatibility construction after bank materialization
disclose body class, hidden observations or the aliased pair to the discoverer
count refusal caused by an empty candidate set as calibrated refusal
describe this bounded result as closing G1, as general epistemic humility or as AGI evidence
